source.title: Applications for Continental Championships 2022 (July 2020)
source.content:
The Board of Directors would like to receive applications for WCA Continental Championships 2022 for the following regions:
1. Africa
2. Oceania
3. South America

Please discuss with the Delegates in your country whether this is something you are willing and able to pursue. Bear in mind that organizing a competition of this size takes a significant amount of time and effort before and during the competition.

If you are interested, send your application documents privately to [board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org) **between July 1st, 2020, 00:00 UTC and September 30th, 2020, 23:59 UTC. Documents must be sent in PDF format in two versions:** one full version with all the details for the application, and another version with sensitive details - if any - removed to make public.
<!-- break -->
Within your application documents, please include at least the following information:

When would you like to hold your Continental Championship 2022?
1a. Possible dates
1b. Number of days of the competition.
1c. Overlap with international holiday periods of schools.

Where would you like to hold your Continental Championship 2022 in your country?
2a. City should be interesting to visit for foreigners with opportunities for sightseeing.
2b. Ease of international, national, and local travel.
2c. Availability of hotels/apartments with different price categories.
2d. Venue, venue size, and venue setup (stage, audience, tables to practice, side rooms).
2e. Technology available like internet, video streaming, lighting, sound equipment.
2f. Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted.

What would the organization team and staff look like?
3a. Core team members.
3b. Experience of the core team.
3c. Involvement of other parties.
3d. Quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 20% of competitors should staff).
3e. Required support by foreign Delegates.

What would be the overall budget for the competition?
4a. Cost (venue, venue services, stage, equipment, decorations, website, badges/lanyards/giftpacks, prizes).
4b. Income (registration fees, sponsoring, local government).

[Here](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8) is an example document with a non-exhaustive list of topics that need to be arranged and budgeted for a large competition.

Once the application period is over, the WCA Board of Directors will interview applicants, consult other WCA Staff members, and vote in order to decide where each 2022 Continental Championship will take place. If any Director will be involved in a team that sends in an application, they will be replaced in the selection process by another person (for example a Senior Delegate or a Committee/Team Leader).

We are looking for a competition that can reinforce our concept of large WCA competitions, boosting the professionalization of our organization and able to offer the competitors the best possible experience and the world the best possible show.

Thank you in advance for your cooperation and we look forward to viewing your applications!

translation.title: 2022 年大洲锦标赛承办申请（2020 年 7 月）
translation.content:
董事会现征集以下地区 2022 年 WCA 大洲锦标赛的承办申请：

1. 非洲
2. 大洋洲
3. 南美洲

请与本国代表商量，确认是否有意愿和能力承办。请记住，组织如此规模的比赛，在赛前及比赛期间都需要投入大量时间和精力。

有意申请者请在 **2020 年 7 月 1 日 00:00 UTC 至 2020 年 9 月 30 日 23:59 UTC 期间**，将材料私下发送至 [board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)。**材料须以 PDF 格式提供两个版本：**包含所有申请细节的完整版，以及删去敏感内容（如有）、可供公开的版本。

申请材料至少须包括以下信息：

计划何时举办 2022 年大洲锦标赛？

1a. 可选日期。
1b. 比赛天数。
1c. 与各国学校假期的重合情况。

计划在本国何处举办 2022 年大洲锦标赛？

2a. 城市应对外国游客有吸引力，并有观光选择。
2b. 国际、国内及当地交通的便利程度。
2c. 不同价位酒店及公寓的供应情况。
2d. 场馆、场馆面积及布置方案（舞台、观众区、练习桌、附属房间）。
2e. 可用技术条件，如网络、视频直播、灯光及音响设备。
2f. 可接待的选手和观众人数。

组织团队和工作人员将如何安排？

3a. 核心团队成员。
3b. 核心团队的经验。
3c. 其他参与方。
3d. 当地志愿者的数量与能力（建议由 20% 的选手参与工作人员工作）。
3e. 需要外国代表提供哪些支持。

比赛总预算如何？

4a. 支出（场租、场馆服务、舞台、器材、装饰、网站、证件／挂绳／礼包、奖品）。
4b. 收入（报名费、赞助、当地政府支持）。

[这里](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8)提供了一份参考文件，列出大型比赛需要安排和编制预算的部分事项，清单并非详尽无遗。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将面试申请者、征询其他 WCA 工作人员的意见，并投票确定各项 2022 年大洲锦标赛的举办地。如有董事参与某个申请团队，其在遴选过程中的位置将由其他人替代，例如高级代表或委员会／团队负责人。

我们希望这场比赛能够进一步体现 WCA 对大型赛事的构想，推动协会更加专业地运作，为选手提供尽可能好的参赛体验，也向世界呈现尽可能精彩的比赛。

提前感谢大家的配合，期待收到你们的申请！
